description: Canonical decision table for the unattended (sleep) posture (D-15). Floor forks are non-delegable: sleep HALTS and waits for a genuine human turn. Non-floor, reversible forks: sleep AUTO-selects the recommended option and proceeds. The D-14 flagship-model escalation, the plan-critique cap, and the D-1 delivery override are all floor forks (human-only levers). check-posture-invariants.py enforces this table; policy/assurance-model.md and policy/model-dispatch.md are its prose.
